questions.question: According to the report, he said, 'The project will be finished by next June.' Which of the following is a more accurate summary of what was actually said?
options: I'll finish the project by July.
He said the project would be finished in time.
The project should be completed soon.
They expect to complete it by then.
questions.answer: He said the project would be finished in time.
